localContext: Paramus's mix of suburban homes, the Bergen Town Center area, and commercial properties along Route 17 creates diverse environments where wasps, hornets, and yellow jackets commonly establish nests in eaves, wall voids, and soffits. The tree-lined neighborhoods and garden-rich properties throughout Paramus provide ideal nesting conditions for wasp and hornet colonies, especially during spring and summer months. Carpenter bees drill into deck railings, fascia boards, and wooden trim. Ground-nesting yellow jackets colonize lawns and landscape beds.
